optimized_multichip_decoder_stage5.status: no change to any persistent allocation vs multichip_decoder_stage4: KV dtype/layout, GDN state dtype, weights dtypes and per-device shapes are unchanged; the stage changed decode matmul grids (attention qkv 72 cores) and replaced the host-written ttnn.zeros buffers of the MoE prefill with device-side allocations (ttnn.empty for the sparse-matmul outputs, ttnn.fill for the routing-matrix scatter target) that are freed inside the prefill call - nothing is cached across calls or layers
optimized_multichip_decoder_stage5.inter_layer_residual_contract: fractured bf16 [1,1,B|T,768] per device between layers; one reduce-scatter per row-parallel boundary (mixer out-proj, MoE exit), one all-gather per norm; no gather/reshard/all-reduce between layers
optimized_multichip_decoder_stage5.prefill_note: 2048-token prefill as 4 x 512-token chunks on the committed default (counting-sort dispatch): host wall 133.0 (GDN) / 128.2 ms (attention) per layer = ~33 / 32 ms per chunk vs ~15.2 / 14.6 ms device per chunk (Tracy 60.97 / 58.23 ms per 2048 tokens, logs/05-perf-plain4.log and 05-final5-chain.log); the host gap is dispatch-bound eager prefill (traced prefill is the optimized-full-model item). No persistent allocation changed vs stage 4.
